_meta.name: Kajuju Lodge knowledge base
_meta.purpose: Grounding source for the evaluation assistant. The assistant must only answer from this file — if something is not here, it must say it doesn't know rather than invent an answer.
_meta.source: Pseudonymized from a crawl of a live boutique-lodge rate-card site. See docs/KnowledgeBase.md for the full source notes and ambiguity list.
_meta.fx_note: Approximate USD conversions in docs use ~130 KES/USD, illustrative only, not live.

property.name: Kajuju Lodge
property.type: Boutique lodge with a self-contained cottage and an on-site café
property.location: Naromoru, at the foot of Mount Kenya, Nyeri County — about 1km off the Nanyuki Highway
property.internet: Fast Starlink WiFi throughout the property
property.road_access: 1km off the highway on an all-weather murram (gravel) road; all car types can manage it, no 4x4 required

rooms.name: Penthouse Loft
rooms.capacity_note: up to 3 adults; extra-guest add-on does not apply here (capped at 3)

rooms.name: Full Lodge Buyout
rooms.description: Exclusive use of the entire property

extra_guest_charge_note: Not applicable to the Penthouse Loft, which is capped at 3 guests.

meal_packages.name: Bed & Breakfast
meal_packages.details: Daily breakfast and a tea tray. Included in the room rate for Twin Garden and Deluxe rooms. The complimentary barista coffee/day is a Workation package perk, not part of the standard B&B rate; see packages.workation.included.

meal_packages.name: Half Board
meal_packages.details: Breakfast plus one main meal (lunch or dinner). Beverages beyond the included coffee/tea are extra.

meal_packages.name: Full Board
meal_packages.details: Breakfast, lunch, and dinner — starter, main, and dessert per meal. Beverages extra.

meal_packages.name: Self-Catering
meal_packages.details: Kitchen access, available in the Penthouse Loft and Cottage.

policies.children: Under 6: free. Ages 6–12: 50% of adult rate.
policies.deposit: 50% required to confirm a booking; balance due on arrival.

cancellation.gap_48_to_72_hours: unspecified in source material — assistant must not guess; say it will confirm with the team

check_in.early_check_in: available on request, subject to availability (workation package lists a 1,500 KES early check-in fee at ~10am; no fixed fee is stated for standard stays)

check_out.late_check_out: subject to availability; no fixed fee stated

policies.pets: Not allowed inside rooms. Leashed pets welcome in the restaurant and outdoor areas. Advance notice requested.

steps: Guest submits a request with dates, room preference, guest count, and meal preference.
Lodge confirms availability and holds the dates for 24 hours.
An invoice with M-Pesa payment details is sent.
A 50% deposit secures the booking; the remaining balance is due at arrival.
booking_flow.note: The assistant cannot check live availability itself,  it must use the check_availability tool (mocked in this evaluation project) or tell the guest it will confirm with the team.

on_property: Short walk to the Naro Moru River — a spot to wade and relax
Nature walks and birdwatching on the grounds
Kids' corner: sandpit, safe grounds, board games
Complimentary morning river walks and evening nature trails (workation package)

nearby.name: Mt Kenya National Park
nearby.distance: ~19km from the property to the nearest gate (Naromoru Gate); a second gate (Sirimon Gate) is roughly a 1-hour drive
nearby.offerings: hiking trails, game drives, guided climbs

nearby.name: Mau Mau Caves guided hike
nearby.details: Guided (fees apply), historic caves with the option to drive up to the waterfall section; meeting point coordinated via a local guiding partner

nearby.name: E-bike rides
nearby.details: Half/full day via a local e-bike partner

nearby.name: Ol Pejeta Conservancy
nearby.offerings: game drives/safaris — rhinos, lions, chimpanzee sanctuary; vehicle rental available

nearby.name: Nanyuki
nearby.offerings: local markets, shops, restaurants, a climbing gym, and a spa/wellness center

nearby.name: Mount Kenya climbs & day hikes
nearby.details: Guide coordination, packed lunches on request, early breakfasts arranged (Sirimon Route)

mountain_climb.name: Mountain Climb Package
mountain_climb.details: Pre-climb night with dinner and breakfast, post-climb recovery meal and shower, guide coordination, transfer connections, day-hike organization, packed meals on request.

workation.name: Workation Package
workation.addons: Half/full board available at standard rates
workation.deposit_and_cancellation: Same 50% deposit / cancellation policy as standard bookings
workation.rate_discrepancy_note: The general rate card lists a different Deluxe Room weekday single rate (10,500) than this workation-specific rate (12,500). Quote the rate matching the guest's stated use case; flag if genuinely ambiguous.

long_stays.name: Long Stays (7+ nights)
long_stays.details: Discounted nightly rates; flexible meal arrangements; contact directly for a custom monthly quote.

birthdays_anniversaries.name: Birthdays & Anniversaries
birthdays_anniversaries.cake: Homemade cakes, 48-hour notice, from ~1,800 KES depending on size, or by the slice
birthdays_anniversaries.room_decoration: 24-hour notice, ~3,500 KES — balloons/decor, personalized touches (e.g. bouquet or wine) on request
birthdays_anniversaries.other: Custom set menus; exclusive-use option available

day_package.typical_group_size: up to 10 people (larger groups handled case-by-case, no fixed upper bound stated)

overnight_retreat.details: Full-lodge takeover across the property's room types, exclusive grounds access, customizable meal plans

menu.hours: Open daily, breakfast through dinner. Last food orders at 9pm.

categories.name: Mains
categories.note: all include a side and seasonal vegetables

menu.dietary_notes: Guests are asked to inform the chef of allergies or dietary requirements. Plant-based milk available for +150 KES. Grilled chicken strip add-on for +250 KES on some dishes.

contact.note: All contact details in this file are fictional placeholders for evaluation purposes.

ambiguities: Cancellation policy for the 48-72 hour window before arrival is not specified in source material.
Deluxe Room weekday single rate differs between the general rate card (10,500 KES) and the workation package page (12,500 KES) — quote based on stated use case.
No upper bound is given for 'larger groups on inquiry' for gatherings.
No pool/gym/spa on-site as of the crawl; a pool was under construction with no completion date given.
Exact calendar boundaries of the 'festive period' (used for minimum-stay rules) are not defined in source material.
No fixed fee for late checkout or early check-in on standard (non-workation) stays.
